title: Ground, Iterate, Trace: Decomposing AI Research Ideation
abstract: arXiv:2611.24887v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models have been widely used to generate plausible research ideas, yet it remains unclear what makes automated ideation effective and how generated novel proposals arise from prior scientific work. We introduce the Creative AI Researcher (CAR), an agentic framework combining literature grounding, iterative development and explicit conceptual operators. CAR constructs a semantic knowledge graph from retrieved literature and equips an ideation agent with graph-retrieval tools and four operators: bisociation, analogy, exploration and elaboration. Each operator call is checked against structural acceptance conditions and recorded, producing a trace of intermediate transformations and declared literature sources. We evaluate CAR with two language-model backbones across 40 LiveIdeaBench research topics and two execution benchmarks. CAR achieves significantly higher methodological novelty (MN) than single-shot prompting and The A

translated_title: 扎根、迭代、追溯：分解AI研究构思
translated_abstract: 大语言模型已被广泛用于生成看似合理的研究想法，但尚不清楚是什么使自动化构思有效，以及生成的新颖提案如何源于先前的科学工作。我们介绍了创造性AI研究者（CAR），这是一个结合文献扎根、迭代开发和显式概念操作符的智能体框架。CAR从检索到的文献中构建语义知识图谱，并为构思智能体配备图谱检索工具和四种操作符：双联、类比、探索和细化。每次操作符调用都会根据结构化接受条件进行检查并记录，从而产生中间转换和声明文献来源的轨迹。我们使用两个语言模型骨干，在40个LiveIdeaBench研究主题和两个执行基准上对CAR进行评估。CAR实现了比单次提示和基线方法显著更高的方法论新颖性（MN）
tldr: 提出了CAR智能体框架，通过文献扎根、语义知识图谱与四种可追溯的概念操作符分解研究构思过程，显著提升了AI生成研究想法的方法论新颖性。
en_tdlr: CAR, an agentic framework that decomposes research ideation through literature grounding, semantic knowledge graphs, and four traceable conceptual operators, significantly improves the methodological novelty of AI-generated research ideas.
